newsitem.title: USA: Tech funds top winners for this week - Lipper.
newsitem.headline: Tech funds top winners for this week - Lipper.

text.p: Science and technology mutual funds captured the biggest gains for the week ended October 11, rising 1.56 percent, according to Lipper Analytical Services.
Canadian funds rose 1.15 percent for the week, Latin American and financial services funds rose 0.52 percent, and world income funds were up 0.41 percent.

The top five performers for the week were Lexington Troika Dialogue Russia, up 6.81 percent; Matthews International: Korea, up 6.22 percent; Fidelity Select Computer, up 4.89 percent; Rainbow Fund, up 4.42 percent; and Fidelity Select Electronics, up four percent.

According to Lipper, the Lexington Troika Dialogue Russifolio was heavily weighted in utilities at 22.48 percent, oil and gas exploration at 18.7 percent, and telecommunications at 10.64 percent, as oly 31.
